parking: Parking is available in the driveway
Please park in designated areas only
Do not block the entrance or exit
addressParking.directions: From downtown Austin, take Highway 290 West for approximately 20 minutes. Turn onto Ledgestone Ter and the property will be on your right.

steps: Arrive at the property at your scheduled check-in time
Use the smart lock code provided in your confirmation email
Enter the code on the keypad to unlock the door
Once inside, locate the welcome packet on the kitchen counter
checkIn.arrivalExpectations: The property will be clean and ready for your arrival. All amenities are fully functional and ready to use.

smartLock.instructions: Enter the 4-digit code on the smart lock keypad located on the front door. The lock will beep and the door will unlock.
troubleshooting: If the code doesn't work, try entering it again slowly
Make sure you're pressing each number firmly
If issues persist, contact the host immediately
